title: CEDAR · The seedling in the yard
venue: the novel of the timber country · never past the corner box · Box 14
logline: The seedling in the mill yard's gravel from the canon's Sunday, a year on and a foot taller, and in the novel it's the one that will go through the house on the logging road: the page draws its future rings faint above it like a diagram of a tree it hasn't grown. The dog waters it.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the mill yard, gravel, a cedar seedling a foot tall, a small three-legged dog beside it.

panels.composition: Tier 2: above the seedling, faint, the tree it will be, drawn in rings and branches like a diagram, rising off the top of the tier.
